title: MulTaBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Tabular Learning with Text and Image
abstract: arXiv:2605.10616v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Tabular Foundation Models have recently established the state of the art in supervised tabular learning, by leveraging pretraining to learn generalizable representations of numerical and categorical structured data. However, they lack native support for unstructured modalities such as text and image, and rely on frozen, pretrained embeddings to process them. On established Multimodal Tabular Learning benchmarks, we show that tuning the embeddings to the task improves performance. Existing benchmarks, however, often focus on the mere co-occurrence of modalities; this leads to high variance across datasets and masks the benefits of task-specific tuning. To address this gap, we introduce MulTaBench, a benchmark of 40 datasets, split equally between image-tabular and text-tabular tasks. We focus on predictive tasks where the modalities provide complementary predictive signal, and where generic embeddings lose critical information,

translated_title: MulTaBench：面向文本与图像的多模态表格学习基准测试
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型通过利用预训练学习数值型和类别型结构化数据的可泛化表示，近来在监督表格学习领域建立了最先进的水平。然而，它们对文本和图像等非结构化模态缺乏原生支持，只能依赖冻结的预训练嵌入来处理这些模态。在现有的多模态表格学习基准上，我们证明了对嵌入进行任务特定的微调能够提升性能。然而，现有基准往往只关注模态的简单共现，这导致跨数据集结果的高方差，并掩盖了任务特定微调带来的收益。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了MulTaBench，一个包含40个数据集的基准，其中图像-表格任务和文本-表格任务各占一半。我们聚焦于模态能够提供互补预测信号、且通用嵌入会丢失关键信息的预测任务。
tldr: 提出了MulTaBench——一个包含40个数据集（图像-表格与文本-表格任务各半）的多模态表格学习基准，专注于模态提供互补预测信号的任务，并证明了对嵌入进行任务特定微调优于使用冻结预训练嵌入。
en_tdlr: We introduce MulTaBench, a benchmark of 40 datasets for multimodal tabular learning with complementary text and image signals, demonstrating that task-specific tuning of embeddings outperforms frozen pretrained embeddings.
